customer_reply:
Hi,

We’ve received your report that a former contractor still has access and was able to export supplier bank details. This is being treated as a security incident. Our Security Team has been alerted and will work with you to contain the issue, preserve evidence, and rotate any compromised credentials. In the meantime, please disable the user’s account immediately and revoke any API keys or tokens associated with that account.

We’ll keep you updated on the next steps.

Best regards,
Support Team
